connector.name: Molpha MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that lets AI agents create, fetch, verify, and publish Molpha oracle data.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the molpha account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SIGNER_BACKEND
env.description: Signing backend: memory (local keypair) or keychain (Privy / Turnkey).

env.name: OWNER_KEYPAIR
env.description: Path to a Solana JSON keypair file. Required when SIGNER_BACKEND=memory.

env.name: KEYCHAIN_BACKEND
env.description: Keychain provider: privy or turnkey. Required when SIGNER_BACKEND=keychain.

env.name: PRIVY_APP_ID
env.description: Privy app ID. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=privy.

env.name: PRIVY_APP_SECRET
env.description: Privy app secret. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=privy.

env.name: PRIVY_WALLET_ID
env.description: Privy wallet ID. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=privy.

env.name: PRIVY_WALLET_ADDRESS
env.description: Solana address for the Privy wallet.

env.name: TURNKEY_API_PUBLIC_KEY
env.description: Turnkey API public key. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=turnkey.

env.name: TURNKEY_API_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Turnkey API private key. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=turnkey.

env.name: TURNKEY_ORGANIZATION_ID
env.description: Turnkey organization ID. Required for KEYCHAIN_BACKEND=turnkey.

env.name: TURNKEY_WALLET_ADDRESS
env.description: Solana address for the Turnkey wallet.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC
env.description: Solana RPC endpoint.

env.name: GATEWAY_ENDPOINTS
env.description: Comma-separated Molpha gateway URLs. Leave empty to use the SDK default.

env.name: MOLPHA_EVM_NETWORKS
env.description: Comma-separated EVM verifier networks.

env.name: MOLPHA_STARKNET_NETWORKS
env.description: Comma-separated Starknet verifier networks.

env.name: MOLPHA_DRY_RUN
env.description: Preview all write and spend operations without submitting them.

env.name: MOLPHA_MAX_EXECUTES_PER_DAY
env.description: Process-local daily Solana submit cap.

env.name: MOLPHA_X402_MAX_PRICE_USDC
env.description: Refuse to fund an x402 round priced above this amount (decimal USDC).

env.name: MOLPHA_X402_MAX_SPEND_PER_DAY_USDC
env.description: Process-local daily x402 spend cap (decimal USDC).

env.name: MOLPHA_X402_GATEWAY_PDA
env.description: Optional settling gateway PDA (base58) to skip discovery when the escrow is already funded.
